reference: Kuraray meeting 13 November 2026 p.7; digitized transmission loss
y11_proxy: Arithmetic mean of YS4 and YS6 loss coefficients [dB/km], not lengths
spectral_observable: First forward crossing by original unshifted primary; WLS descendants tracked in separate broadband count
reference_geometry: Near-axis monochromatic launch; path equals axial distance; no input/output coupling factor
acceptance: All planes: |p_native-p_reference| < 6 binomial standard errors + 0.002 absolute; model-input consistency, not experimental validation

Y-11.method: Conditional multinomial ML of first-crossing survival; nested counts; single long component; curvature errors
Y-11.note: Diagnostic effective fit in 1-6 m window; spectral mixture is not necessarily exponential; not a pass/fail calibration target
